name: @stefanasemota/stripe-core-service
description: A portable, config-driven Stripe integration layer for Next.js and Firebase environments.

scripts.prepare: npm run build && (test -d .git && npx husky install || true)
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push origin main --tags

author: Stefan Asemota
